LESSON: WEATHER ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.3: Weather ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Weather ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the weather ENVIRONMENT learner should be able to; weather conditions of the day condition of the day?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

2. respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WEATHER ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Weather ENVIRONMENT helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: WEATHER ENVIRONMENT
Weather ENVIRONMENT is part of Science learning. Connect every idea to something you can observe.
Use safe examples only. Do not try dangerous experiments without a teacher.
Write definitions in your own words, then add one drawing or real-life example.

PART 1: Observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather

What this means
In this part you learn to observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Weather ENVIRONMENT” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos

What this means
In this part you learn to respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Weather ENVIRONMENT matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Weather ENVIRONMENT is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Weather ENVIRONMENT” around your school. (skill: observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather)

Example 2: Say why Weather ENVIRONMENT matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Weather ENVIRONMENT to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather.
3. Practise this skill: respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Weather ENVIRONMENT from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Weather ENVIRONMENT: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Weather ENVIRONMENT?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the weather ENVIRONMENT learner should be able to; weather conditions of the day condition of the day?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Weather ENVIRONMENT means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: observe weather conditions in • Learners are guided to talk about 2. How do you respond ( 10 Lessons) the immediate environment weather conditions they have to different weather.
5. Be able to: respond to weather conditions different weather conditions by appropriately in the immediate observing pictures, charts and environment watching videos.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
